findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
The following equipment is observed to be in need of repair: 

1. THIRD REPEAT- The deli/bakery walk-in cooler is observed to have ice accumulation on the ground and coming from the fan units. Ensure that the issue causing the ice build-up is repaired and that all the ice is scraped off to allow the floor to be smooth and easily cleanable. Due to this being a third repeat violation, a follow up is scheduled for 7/13/2026 to ensure that this violation is corrected. 

2. The shelf closest to the door on the left side of the deli walk-in cooler is observed to be significantly rusted on the bottom shelf. Ensure that this shelf is repaired or replaced to prevent contamination to food from rust. 

Ensure that equipment is maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(A) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The hood baffles. 
2. SECOND REPEAT- The floor under the fryers in the kitchen of the deli is observed to have an accumulation of grease and food debris on them. Ensure that these floors are being regularly cleaned to prevent the accumulation of soil residues. 
3. The wall and baseboard under the kitchen triple sink. 
4. The dish shelves to the right of the kitchen triple sink. 
5. The floor to the right of and behind the Henny Penny in the kitchen of the deli. 

Ensure that physical facilities are being cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: At the start of the inspection, the sanitizer bucket was tested and recorded at 0ppm QUAT. The QUAT dispenser at the triple sink was tested and recorded at 200ppm. The sanitizer bucket was removed from service and remade with a fresh sanitizer solution and recorded at 200ppm. Ensure that the sanitizer bucket is tested and changed at a frequency necessary to maintain its efficacy.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The tile floor in the kitchen is observed to be in a state of major disrepair in the kitchen area. There are observed floor tiles cracked, broken, missing pieces, and areas with low to no grout present. The tile floor, according to the PIC, has been addressed with a work order having been placed. Ensure these floor tiles and grout areas are repaired/replaced to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface that prevents the accumulation of food debris and water. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Both hand sinks in the deli did not have paper towels in the dispenser. One pack of ‘wipe alls’ was available for use, but paper towels are needed at each hand sink. Paper towels were restocked during the inspection. Ensure all paper towel dispensers are refilled after running out. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: 2-301.12: (A) Observed 2 food employees put on gloves without first washing hands. Employees removed gloves and washed hands. Wash hands each time before gloves are used.  FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment: 4-903.11: Observed wall mounted knife holders in kitchen area (above slicer and above mixer) to be soiled with food splash and debris. Remove knife holders from wall and wash, rinse and sanitize. (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean

(C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment: 3-501.17: (A) Observed opened half gallon container of milk in walk-in cooler to have no date mark.   Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment: 7-202.12: (A) Observed containers of quaternary ammonia sanitizer to be stored in walk in cooler.  Manufacturer specifies that these chemicals should be stored between 50 and 120 degrees F.  POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be used according to LAW(C), Manufacturer’s directions (indicate for use in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT) (P), conditions of certification (if applicable) (P), and additional conditions (if applicable) (C). (B) POISIONOUS MATERIALS shall be applied so HAZARD is not constituted to individuals and contamination from chemical is prevented (P).(C) RESTRICTED USE PESTICIDE shall be applied only by certified applicator. (Pf)
